remarks:
Discover the perfect blend of convenience and country living with this nearly 10-acre buildable lot in Bliss, NY.
Ready for your dream home, cabin, or recreational getaway, this property already features a drilled well, septic system, and electric service-saving you time and money as you build. Over half of the property is wooded, offering privacy, natural beauty, and abundant wildlife, while the open areas provide excellent building sites and room for gardens, recreation, or additional improvements. Whether you're looking for a peaceful rural retreat, a hunting property, or a place to build your forever home, this versatile parcel offers endless possibilities. Enjoy the tranquility of the countryside while still being within easy driving distance of nearby towns and amenities.
Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a nearly 10-acre ready-to-build property in the heart of Wyoming County.
Please do not walk the property without your agent. It is owner occupied.
